name: What types of electrical upgrades are typically involved in a modern bathroom renovation?
description: Modern bathroom electrical upgrades often include new circuits, GFCI outlets, smart home integration, and various LED lighting options.

mainEntity.name: What types of electrical upgrades are typically involved in a modern bathroom renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Modern bathroom electrical upgrades often include installing dedicated circuits for high-wattage appliances like jetted tubs or tankless water heaters, updating GFCI outlets for safety, and incorporating smart home technology. Lighting improvements commonly involve LED recessed lighting, task lighting around mirrors, and accent lighting. The specific upgrades depend on the existing electrical infrastructure and your desired features. For Frasheski Construction projects in the East Bay, we assess current wiring and panel capacity during the initial consultation to ensure all planned additions are safely supported.
acceptedAnswer.description: Modern bathroom electrical upgrades often include new circuits, GFCI outlets, smart home integration, and various LED lighting options.
